name: Chicago Golf Club (prairie links, Wheaton)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Chicago Golf Club, Wheaton IL: Macdonald and Raynor's flat prairie links. Fairways and greens in marovitz's cool bluegrass greens; a mown band of green rough beside every fairway (lut rough_band G3-G5) and wide native fescue between the holes, olive-tawny in late summer (F0-F2, drawn where data/chicago_golf/proposed/fescue.geojson says, config fescue_areas); the walking paths are pale crushed gravel (K2-K4 lighter and warmer than marovitz's asphalt). Colours set from the NAIP 2023 photo (fescue median #727a5a, mown rough #637652, paths #b1ae94), warmed and lifted to sit with the other themes. Trees as marovitz (trees_marovitz: elm, honey locust, cottonwood, spruce, pine). Course chat, 2026-11-13.
